summary: The Acura MDX, called the Honda MDX in Japan and Australia (where only the first generation was imported), is a mid-size three-row luxury crossover built by Honda under its Acura nameplate since 2000. The name stands for "Multi-Dimensional luxury." According to Honda, it is the best-selling three-row luxury crossover of all time, with cumulative U.S. sales expected to pass 700,000 units before the end of 2014. It ranks as the second-best selling luxury crossover behind the Lexus RX, which has only two rows of seats.
one_line: The Acura MDX is a mid-size three-row luxury crossover produced by Honda under the Acura nameplate since 2000.
